desktop.notes:
• Photo view / fullscreen: ↑ zooms in, ↓ zooms out (back to fit at the bottom). Lists and text boxes keep their arrows.
• Alt + drag pans the photo; in fullscreen fill a plain drag pans too.
• Fullscreen fill reaches a few pixels past every edge.
